sources.title: Minutes of the 507th Meeting of the National Security Council
sources.author_or_institution: John F. Kennedy Presidential Library and Museum
supports: Air strike could not guarantee destruction of every missile
Kennedy compared an unannounced strike to Pearl Harbor
An air strike risked leading to invasion

sources.title: October 23, 1962 — Cuban Missile Crisis
sources.author_or_institution: John F. Kennedy Presidential Library and Museum
supports: Kennedy signed Proclamation 3504 authorizing the naval quarantine
The quarantine created a controlled point of contact with Soviet shipping

sources.title: The Cuban Missile Crisis, October 1962
sources.author_or_institution: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
supports: Private indication that obsolete Jupiter missiles would be removed
Missiles withdrawn and quarantine later ended

sources.title: October 27 Joint Chiefs Notes and Unknown Soviet Warheads
sources.author_or_institution: National Security Archive, George Washington University
supports: U.S. intelligence did not know the location and readiness of Soviet nuclear warheads in Cuba during the crisis
An invasion carried escalation risks not visible at T0
